findings: The defect is real at the existing collapsed owner surface: correct heartbeat text lives under details, which becomes GONE.
The repair must compose the existing heartbeat model into a surviving existing control; it must not create a neighboring renderer/controller or new recovery lane.
A correct pure projection is insufficient unless OperatorOverlayService actually assigns it to a surviving collapsed accessibility surface.
Source success must not be promoted into Android runtime, TalkBack runtime, deployment, phone delivery, or acceptance.
